body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P(d,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L)\), consistency and conditional exchangeability imply \(\tau_P(x)=\mathbb E_P[Y(1)-Y(0)\mid X=x]\) for \(P_X\)-almost every \(x\). Exact full support and continuity determine a unique version on all of \(\mathcal X\), including \(\tau_P(0)\).
body.justification: The proposition separates a measure-zero conditional-mean convention from the statistical precision problem.
body.gap: KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024MinimaxCATE identifies CATE under overlap; the present endpoint formulation additionally records why exact full support and continuity identify the boundary value.
body.consumer: Users of pointwise CATE methods can interpret the lower bound as loss of precision rather than failure of causal identification.
